regions.merged_text: Its nearly a year now since your little visit the St. Felix Friary .. Many thanks for your kind favor of June 11th duly received and noted. I hope you proffit by your stay in Phoenix and that on your return home to Hamtramck you find mother and Sister better than ever. I hope to leave here and return to St. Felix shortly. How little we can appreciate our health until it fails us. So we really ought to thank God for trials and crosses as well as for joys and consolations.
